name: generate_image
description: Generate an image from a text prompt using gpt-image-1.

prompt.description: The text prompt describing the image to generate.

size.description: Image size. One of: 1024x1024, 1536x1024, 1024x1536. Defaults to 1024x1024.

quality.description: Image quality. One of: low, medium, high. Defaults to medium.

output_format.description: Output format. One of: png, jpeg, webp. Defaults to png.
